action.content:
Step 1: Turn off the water supply located at the wall behind the existing toilet and flush the toilet to drain most of the water from the tank.
***
Step 2: Disconnect the supply line from the bottom of the current toilet tank and use a wet vacuum or a bucket to remove any remaining water from the trapway and bowl.
***
Step 3: Remove the nuts and bolts securing the toilet to the floor, carefully lifting the old toilet straight up and away to avoid breaking the wax ring seal.
***
Step 4: Scrape away the old wax ring and any residual sealant from the floor flange and the bottom of the new toilet to ensure a clean surface for the new installation.
***
Step 5: Place a fresh wax ring (or a wax-free alternative) over the floor flange, centering it properly before lowering the new toilet bowl onto it.

Let me know how it works. I can give you next steps when you finish all steps above.
